notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping Coretapper and Magistrate's Scepter and causing you to gain two life.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
